exports.signature: pub fn push(state: &mut SyntaxState, bytes: &[u8]) -> Result<()>
exports.behavior: Retains the complete chunk after checked payload growth and fallible reservation. Does not parse. Empty chunks are accepted before EOF. All pushes after EOF or successful finish fail, and the first error remains sticky.

Resumes monotonic token-boundary discovery, validates complete tokens, consumes silent punctuation through machine and frames, and emits exactly one event with the cursor immediately after its token. Handles strict JSON numbers and literals, UTF-8, string escapes, surrogate pairs, raw and decoded ownership, resource limits, EOF classification, and idempotent completion.

test_vectors.coverage: Unparsed invalid chunks, empty chunks, zero and exact payload ceilings, rejected growth without appended bytes, EOF and finished behavior, repeated completion, and preservation of original error metadata including schema and field context.

Exact nested object/array/key/scalar events, spans, delimiter offsets, frame depth, silent commas and colons, whitespace consumption, and an incomplete number held at its start while scan_offset advances.

Every two-chunk split of scalar and nested documents, one-byte feeds splitting UTF-8 and UTF-16 escape pairs, odd and even backslash runs, a 1024-byte growing string, repeated NeedMore without arena mutation, and number/keyword boundary waiting.

Empty strings, all JSON escapes, embedded NUL, Unicode scalar-width boundaries, mixed raw UTF-8 and escapes, minimum and maximum surrogate pairs, exact scalar counts, raw versus arena references, and reference stability through 512 subsequent escaped values.

Large raw integers and exponents, fractions, signs, leading zeros, malformed exponent and fraction forms, forbidden numeric spellings, exact lowercase literals, adjacent token suffixes, all four JSON whitespace bytes, and non-JSON whitespace rejection. Quoted digit sequences remain strings.

Invalid escapes and hex digits, lone low and high surrogates, invalid pairs, every unescaped control byte, malformed keys and nested values, invalid UTF-8 lead and continuation bytes, overlong encodings, encoded surrogates, code points above U+10FFFF, and truncated UTF-8.

Empty documents, open containers, missing values, unfinished literals and numbers, truncated escapes, unclosed strings, lexical-error precedence, trailing garbage, missing separators, mismatched delimiters, unquoted keys, and trailing commas.

Zero and exact string limits, raw escape spelling lengths, incomplete oversized strings, key byte limits, cumulative arena budgets, multi-byte arena boundaries, all exponent digits, the exact u16 maximum number-digit count and one additional digit, depth zero, empty containers under zero count limits, and decoded duplicate-key equality.

Lexical failures leave no partial decoded string, rejected escaped duplicate keys roll back unpublished arena bytes, frame counters and phases remain unchanged on rejection, and every split of representative malformed documents produces the same sticky error.

Deterministic usize capacity overflow, unchanged storage contents, zero reservations, exact u32 arena end, checked arena overflow, configured arena ceilings, and defensive InternalError handling for inconsistent carry and cursor bounds.
